title: Constructible complete proper base change
statement:
Use the adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] with $A=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi)$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the full categories $\Dbc(T_{\Proet},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be the cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $X,Y,X',Y'$ noetherian of finite dimension, $f$ and $f'$ proper, a positive integer $N$ annihilating $A/I$ invertible on all four schemes, and geometric fibers of $f$ of dimension at most $e\geq0$, as in [prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible]. Then the specified completed exchange [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] restricts to a natural isomorphism of ordinary triangulated functors
$$
 Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*(-)
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}(-)
 :\Dbc(X_{\Proet},A)\longrightarrow\Dbc(Y'_{\Proet},A),
$$
where completed pullback is [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Its component at each $K$ is exactly the isomorphism of [thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale]. The coefficient category here is the completed $A_T$-module category of the cited definitions, without an identification with a condensed rational-coefficient category.

note:
*Source note:* the isomorphism is Stacks Project, Pro-etale Cohomology,
Theorem 61.30.1 ([Tag 09C9](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C9)) with
$K$ satisfying its conditions, and the category $\Dbc(T_{\Proet},A)$ is that
of Definition 61.29.1 ([Tag
09C1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C1)); the blueprint adds the
restriction of the tower-level theorem to $\Dbc(X_{\Proet},A)$, with the
amplitude bookkeeping proved in
[prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible].

proof.text: The residue characteristic l divides N: its image in the residue ring is zero, so its p-adic norm is less than one. Invertibility of N gives invertibility of l on X and Y-prime. Apply uniform complete triangulation to get the two inherited triangulations.

Apply the original-datum constructible-preservation proposition to each full-subcategory object. Its second and fourth outputs give the source and target membership functions; the adic datum and completed coefficient categories are unchanged.

The canonical reduction-tower universal property provides an integer-shift comparison and exactness. Strict tower pullback is the derived functor of an exact additive functor; completed Rlim and ordinary direct image are right derived additive functors. Hence the source composite is exact, and its full-subcategory lift is exact with the inherited triangles.

Construct the ambient exchange natural transformation explicitly: whisker the reduction/pullback comparison, integral exchange, natural strict projection, inverse comparison, and direct-image/Rlim comparison. Functor.map_comp and cancellation identify its component with the specified ordered completedExchange. Restrict its maps using fullness. CompleteProetale_isIso applies to the intrinsic completeness and compatible origins carried by membership. The full inclusion reflects componentwise invertibility, so Mathlib constructs the natural isomorphism.

Transport the source shift comparison through this explicit natural isomorphism using Functor.CommShift.ofIso. Its compatibility theorem makes the very same exchange commute with shifts. Functor.isTriangulated_of_iso proves target exactness. The restricted component equation is the proved ambient component equation.

blueprint_update.statement:
Under the hypotheses of [prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible], the
theorem [thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale] restricts to a natural isomorphism
of ordinary triangulated functors
$$
 Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K
 \quad\text{in }\Dbc(Y'_{\Proet},A)
$$
for every $K\in\Dbc(X_{\Proet},A)$.

proof.text:
The isomorphism of [thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale] exists for every derived
complete $K$ with compatible witnesses; the preservation proposition
[prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible] shows that all four displayed
objects lie in the bounded constructible complete category of
[def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], so the isomorphism lands
there.
